analyzed_vuln.description: FieldFromFlatbuffer dereferences field->name()->str() in the dictionary-encoding branch without validating that field->name() is non-null. Unlike the non-dictionary branch (which checks name==nullptr), the dictionary path omits this check, so malformed Flatbuffer metadata with a null/invalid name pointer causes an out-of-bounds read/SEGV inside flatbuffers::String::str()/Vector::size().
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The IPC stream reader accepts attacker-controlled Flatbuffer schema metadata (from FuzzIpcStream -> RecordBatchStreamReader::ReadSchema -> GetSchema -> FieldFromFlatbuffer). Trigger requires a Field that is parsed as dictionary-encoded (field->dictionary()!=nullptr) while its name pointer is null or corrupted. Because no verifier/validation rejects this before use in that branch, calling field->name()->str() crashes.
